purpose: Same-backbone ASR adaptation, stricter speaker operating point, independent intent replication

speech_data.source: Pinned LibriSpeech train.100; bounded source-prefix sample
speech_data.training: 16 recordings from each of the existing 48 training speakers
speech_data.evaluation: 20 validation and 30 test speakers absent from every earlier manifest; five enrollment recordings from one chapter, five probes from another

asr.adapter: Decoder query/value LoRA, rank 8, alpha 16, dropout 0.05
asr.augmentation: Half clean, half 15 dB Gaussian noise
asr.selection: Minimum generated clean validation WER; unchanged pretrained baseline wins ties
asr.test: Clean and 10 dB Gaussian noise, paired speaker bootstrap, same backbone

speaker.centering: Mean of two recordings from each training speaker; no evaluation data
speaker.selection: Minimum validation FRR within empirical FAR cap; then lower FAR; then listed order
speaker.test: All probe/enrollment identity pairs; paired probe-speaker bootstrap conditional on enrollment cohort
speaker.warning: An empirical development cap does not guarantee a population or test false-accept rate

intent.sampling: Every eligible unique 1–30 second recording, excluding all prior source IDs, normalized transcripts and audio checksums
intent.training: None; freeze all v1/v2 weights, preprocessing and v2 alpha=0.25
intent.primary_comparison: Previously selected v2 probability blend against frozen v1 fusion
intent.statistics: Language-stratified paired bootstrap and two-sided exact McNemar; intent-cluster bootstrap sensitivity
intent.scope: External English-variety replication, supplied transcripts, speaker identities unavailable
intent.secondary: V2 text-only and joint ensembles; no selection from test results

publication: Aggregate metrics, positional aliases, anonymous speaker groups, sufficient error counts and predictions; no raw source transcripts, recording identifiers, audio provenance, or per-record speaker embeddings
